method: 每项保持纸源或独立音证支持的正文词，仅映射到同一实际完整词声段；无猜秒、无词尾/词内比例插值、无全局不同词合并。

bindings.source_sentence_en: Today we are pleased to have invited Maggie Shorts from Harvard University to tell us her feeling of studying together with her mom.
bindings.evidence: 纸源数字解析与B1教材均印Maggie Shorts；原音同一姓名位置模型转Schwartz。保留有纸源依据的专名拼写，仅绑定该真实整词声段，不据模型另造人名。
bindings.evidence_ref: 核验/正文清理/2016-人工词锚证据.json

bindings.source_sentence_en: Last fall, I was chastised for passing along a speculative tidbit I had heard in the dining hall—that, because of grade inflation, GPAs once considered good might be viewed with new scrutiny.
bindings.evidence: 纸源grade inflation、GPAs once considered good与中文成绩背景一致。两局部模型此处均误记great；grade/great在此辅音连接处不能靠ASR判字，保留明确纸源术语grade inflation，并把词锚绑定到原声实际对应整词，不声称双模型转写已一致。
bindings.evidence_ref: 核验/正文清理/2016-人工词锚证据.json

bindings.source_sentence_en: Is the phenomenon of parent and kids studying together at university a rare case?
bindings.evidence: 纸源kids，独立Whisper1121—1146也读kids；主/局部Parakeet读kid。保留有纸源及独立模型依据的复数，不将kid/kids加入全局等价表；此处只共用真实完整词段。
bindings.evidence_ref: 核验/正文清理/2016-人工词锚证据.json
